title: The game's the thing... or is it?
book_use: Olympic-time account of local Greek baseball players and Who's on First documentary; reports only 2 of 13 locally trained players selected and coach Dimitris Gousios resignation; captures process grievance rather than simple skill denial

title: Greece to Pay Tribute to Its Beloved Baseball Coach
book_use: Reports local Greek players competing for roster spots admired Derksen because he taught them the game; complicates simple diaspora-versus-local framing

title: Are there baseball teams in Greece?
book_use: 20-year retrospective: Mazarakis calls Olympic-only development model a mistake; documents continuing diaspora dependence local-field shortages and youth-development challenge; use as institutional retrospective not neutral adjudication

title: History
book_use: Federation-side competitive rationale for diaspora roster; says qualifying team had 22 North Americans and 2 local-league players and Olympic team was overwhelmingly diaspora-based; useful counterweight to local-player grievance
